description: Runtime binding for the five logical Agents (#2014). Judgment-relevant declarations live only in agents/contracts/*.agent.json; this document may declare mechanism, surface and fallback and nothing else.

claude.note: Measured from the frontmatter line `tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash`. Read maps to read-artifact and read-source, Grep/Glob to search-source, Bash to run-command.

codex.note: Measured from `interface.capabilities: ["Read"]`. The manifest declares neither an `agents` nor a `commands` key, so the only surface shared with Claude is skills/agent-skills/.
Codex has no agent primitive, so the entry skill carries the Agent. Delivery differs, judgment does not.
One instance per reviewer role; the lens skills under skills/agent-skills/river-review-* are the shared surface.

claude.note: Verification is deterministic (src/lib/verifier.mjs), so the binding carries no model-side capability requirement on either runtime.
No implementation exists yet on either runtime, so an unsatisfiable binding escalates to a human instead of returning an empty assessment.
